_about: Server-side CRASH defects (5xx / connection-reset / hang) that the schema-guided fuzz lane (fuzz_gate.py) discovered in a GOLDEN reference, has diagnosed to a minimal reproduction, and is tracking upstream. The fuzz gate reports these LOUDLY on every run but does NOT fail on them (a crash we have already diagnosed and are tracking is not new information every run). Every entry MUST carry a minimal_repro, a root-cause diagnosis, and an `upstream` reference (a filed issue/PR, or a documented candidate paired with the sibling upstream artifact that establishes the defect class). Entries EXPIRE BY CONSTRUCTION: `signature` names the corpus cases that must still crash; the moment NONE of them reproduce the crash, the gate FAILS until the entry is deleted, so a stale acknowledgement can never quietly outlive the bug it described. A NEW crash matching no entry FAILS the gate.
